_note: One entry per wrap-up (stage 7), newest last, only in entries. Storage: design-log.json in the project folder and, if writable, ~/.unaverage/direction-log.json with the entries of all brands. Read in stage 0: entries of the same brand with a direction the user chose set consistency (continue direction, fonts, palette, signature element). The last three entries of other brands steer rotation: their chosen directions lose ties, their display fonts are swapped for an equally fitting pairing. Signature element and prop rotate the same way: what carried for these three brands loses ties. _example is fictional (Weserbogen from directions/README.md 11.7), shows only the format and never counts for consistency or rotation.

_fields.brand: brand name, same spelling in all entries; key for consistency and rotation
_fields.use_case: case ID from use-cases/README.md, with the addition where the case matrix has several rows (for example B1 B2B industry)
_fields.register: Operate, Persuade, Read, Feed or Distance
_fields.mode: null, Correction, Review only, Autonomous or No user available
_fields.r0: category default and own asset (null if none)
_fields.set: the three shown or computed directions with class and score S
_fields.seed: value, pool in order, hit index; null if not drawn
_fields.chosen: chosen direction: code, name, candidate, accent, dose, whether the recommendation was followed
_fields.discarded: directions not chosen, with the reason in the user's words
_fields.fonts: live families with role and weights
_fields.palette: colors with hex and role, plus the saturation strategy A, B or C
_fields.signature_element: one sentence; name a carrying prop here too (for example stamp or highlighter fill)
_fields.generic_index: index after triage in the delivered result
_fields.folder: path to the result, relative to the project folder
_fields.note: deviations, user wishes for the next work on this brand
